subject: Physics
question_text: A particle is projected with a velocity u at an angle theta with the horizontal. The magnitude of change in velocity when it reaches the highest point is:
explanation: Initial velocity vector v_i = u cos(theta)i + u sin(theta)j. At the highest point, v_f = u cos(theta)i. Change in velocity delta_v = v_f - v_i = -u sin(theta)j. Magnitude = u sin(theta).

subject: Physics
question_text: A force F = (3x^2 + 2x) N acts on a body of mass 2 kg moving along the x-axis. The work done by this force in displacing the body from x = 1 m to x = 3 m is:
explanation: Work done W = integral(F dx) from 1 to 3. W = integral(3x^2 + 2x) dx = [x^3 + x^2] from 1 to 3 = (27 + 9) - (1 + 1) = 36 - 2 = 34 J.

subject: Chemistry
question_text: Which of the following species has a see-saw geometry?
explanation: SF4 has 4 bond pairs and 1 lone pair around the central sulfur atom (sp3d hybridization), resulting in a see-saw molecular geometry.

subject: Chemistry
question_text: For an endothermic reaction to be spontaneous at temperature T, which of the following conditions must be satisfied?
options: Delta H > 0 and T Delta S > Delta H
Delta H > 0 and T Delta S < Delta H
correct_option: Delta H > 0 and T Delta S > Delta H
explanation: Spontaneity requires Delta G = Delta H - T Delta S < 0. For an endothermic reaction (Delta H > 0), Delta G becomes negative only if T Delta S > Delta H.
